comment: HS mapping vs declared 071220/071290/090411/090412: 071220 (dried onions, whole/cut/sliced/powdered) - EXACT, covers the entire dehydrated white/red/pink onion line, the company's core product. 071290 (other dried vegetables) - PARTIAL/understated: covers dehydrated garlic (0712.90) and the vegetable powders (tomato, spinach, carrot, mint, amchur, bitter gourd, green chilli, lemon) only if genuinely dehydrated-and-powdered rather than extracts; if they are spray-dried extracts the correct heading is 1302, not 0712. 090411 (pepper, neither crushed nor ground) - WRONG for the listed item: the site sells BLACK PEPPER POWDER, which is 090412 (crushed/ground), not 090411; no whole peppercorn product page found. 090412 - EXACT for black pepper powder. MISSING from the declaration (product lines present on site but no declared code): dried red chilli and chilli crushed/powder (0904.21/0904.22), cinnamon (0906.11/0906.19), cloves (0907.10/0907.20), nutmeg (0908.11/0908.21), green cardamom (0908.31), coriander (0909.21/0909.22), cumin (0909.31/0909.32), fennel (0909.61/0909.62), turmeric (0910.30), ginger powder (0910.12), mustard (1207.50), and the whole spray-dried fruit powder range (0803/0813 or 1106.30 depending on form) - this is a substantial part of the catalogue and is entirely absent from the 4 declared codes. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right but imprecise: the company is a dehydrated-vegetable/spice-ingredient processor (B2B bulk ingredient supplier), not FMCG-branded retail. Trader signs: no factory address on the site beyond a claimed Mahuva plant, no certifications named, no capacity/equipment data, no product-level technical sheets - consistent with a processor-trader mix. Per project rule 3, the HS gaps are NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, codes corrected to the actual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product claims here are from the company's own website only - no customs line was available in this task, so every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No registry, revenue or shipment research performed (out of scope for this role).
